legal.privacyBody1: PaperBuilder stores school, teacher and student information only to run the school's exams and papers. It is never sold or shared with advertisers.
legal.privacyBody2: This is a demo platform. The data shown here is sample data. The full privacy policy is agreed when a school is onboarded.
legal.termsBody1: PaperBuilder is a school examination and paper management platform. Schools use it to build, approve and print exam papers from their own question banks.
legal.termsBody2: This is a demo platform. Accounts, schools and papers shown here are sample data. Real terms are agreed when a school is onboarded.
